# 5-Day Madrid to Lisbon Trip Comparison

Both plans fit a **couple’s €1,200 ground budget** for 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-15, excluding flights. Plan A is more culture-heavy; Plan B is more varied and easier to keep relaxed.

## Plan A vs Plan B: Cost, Pace, and Fit

| Plan | Daily Cost Estimate | 5-Day Total | Pace | Best For | Relaxed Trip Fit |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| Plan A: Museums + Historic Sites | €190–€230 | €950–€1,150 | Moderate-to-busy | First-time visitors who want major landmarks | Good, but more walking and time in museums |
| Plan B: Food Markets + Viewpoints + Day Trip | €170–€220 | €850–€1,100 | Easy-to-moderate | Couples who want variety, scenery, and downtime | **Better** for a relaxed trip |

## Best Choice for a Relaxed Couple’s Trip

### Plan B: Food, Views, and One Day Trip
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Why it wins:** fewer museum-heavy blocks, more flexible pacing, and more “pause-and-enjoy” moments.
- **Mood:** scenic mornings, long lunches, sunset viewpoints, and one bigger outing outside the city.
- **Cost comfort:** it leaves more room for nice dinners, coffee stops, and a mid-range hotel without feeling rushed.

### Plan A: Museums and Historic Sites
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Why it works:** strong if your priority is classic Lisbon history and indoor activities.
- **Trade-off:** can feel denser day-to-day, especially if you stack Belém, Alfama, and multiple museums.
- **Best when:** you want a more structured itinerary and don’t mind a fuller schedule.

## Estimated Daily Costs by Plan

### Plan A: Museums + Historic Sites
- **Day 1:** €180–€210 — arrival, central stroll, light dinner
- **Day 2:** €200–€230 — major museums + historic districts
- **Day 3:** €190–€220 — Belém sights, monuments, pastries, riverfront
- **Day 4:** €180–€220 — old town neighborhoods, cathedral/church visits, viewpoints
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4c/Lisbon_%281600%29_detail_1.jpg Alt=Day 4:** €180–€220 — old town neighborhoods, cathedral/church visits, viewpoints, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Day 5:** €200–€270 — final sightseeing, shopping, farewell meal

### Plan B: Food Markets + Scenic Viewpoints + Day Trip
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Day 1:** €160–€190 — arrival, market dinner, easy evening
Media: Alt=Day 1:** €160–€190 — arrival, market dinner, easy evening, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Day 2:** €170–€210 — food hall or market crawl, tram ride, viewpoints
- **Day 3:** €180–€220 — scenic neighborhoods, riverfront, relaxed lunch
- **Day 4:** €220–€280 — day trip with transport, meals, and entry fees
- **Day 5:** €170–€220 — slow breakfast, last viewpoints, departure prep

## Practical Recommendation

- Choose **Plan A** if you want the trip to feel like a classic city break with museums, monuments, and a stronger historical focus.
- Choose **Plan B** if you want the trip to feel more balanced, romantic, and low-stress.
- For a couple traveling together, **Plan B is the better relaxed option** because it naturally builds in more unstructured time and fewer “must-see” blocks per day.
